Enclosing class:

public static record H3RasterAggregator.RasterArgbBuffer(int width, int height, int[] argb) extends Record
Unified immutable snapshot of an ARGB raster backed by a flat primitive pixel array.

  • Method Details

    • fromBufferedImage

      public static H3RasterAggregator.RasterArgbBuffer fromBufferedImage(BufferedImage img)
      Extracts a flat ARGB (or 16-bit tagged grayscale) pixel buffer from a headless BufferedImage. Preserves full 16-bit unsigned resolution (65,536 levels) when the source image is BufferedImage.TYPE_USHORT_GRAY.
      Parameters:
      img - source buffered image (may be null)
      Returns:
      extracted buffer, or null when input is null/empty

    • fromFxImage

      public static H3RasterAggregator.RasterArgbBuffer fromFxImage(javafx.scene.image.Image img)
      Extracts a flat ARGB pixel buffer from a JavaFX Image.
      Parameters:
      img - source JavaFX image (may be null)
      Returns:
      extracted buffer, or null when input is null/unreadable

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
